description_en: Call the SetDcdnFullDomainsBlockIP operation to block or unblock specified IP addresses or CIDR blocks
description_zh: 调用SetDcdnFullDomainsBlockIP可以对指定的IP或IP段，进行封禁解禁操作
name: SetDcdnFullDomainsBlockIP

parameters.help_en: The IP addresses or CIDR blocks to block or unblock. Separate multiple entries with commas (,). You can specify a maximum of 1,000 IP addresses or CIDR blocks
parameters.help_zh: 封禁或解禁IP列表，有多个IP时请用半角逗号（,）分隔，最大支持1000个IP
parameters.name: ip_list

parameters.help_en:
The action to perform. Valid values:

block: Blocks the specified IP addresses.

unblock: Unblocks the specified IP addresses
parameters.help_zh:
操作动作。取值：
block：封禁。
unblock：解禁
parameters.name: operation_type

parameters.help_en: The block duration. Unit: seconds. A value of 0 indicates a permanent block. This parameter is valid only when OperationType is set to block
parameters.help_zh: 封禁时长，单位为秒。设置为0时表示永久封禁。仅当OperationType为block时有效
parameters.name: block_interval

parameters.help_en:
The update type for the block duration. This parameter is valid only when OperationType is set to block. Valid values:

cover: The new block duration overwrites the existing one.

uncover: The longer of the new and existing block durations is used.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value cover is used
parameters.help_zh:
封禁时间类别。仅当OperationType为block时有效。取值：

cover：当前请求是采取配置覆盖方式。
uncover：采取时间计算比对最长方式。
该参数为空时默认采取配置覆盖方式
parameters.name: update_type

Code.description_en:
The result code.

A value of 0 indicates that the request was successful. A non-zero value indicates that the request failed. Possible causes of a failure include incomplete parameters or incorrect parameter formats
Code.description_zh:
结果信息码。

Code不为0的可能情况：参数不全、参数格式不正确等
